All tests pass. The implementation is complete and fully tested. Here's a summary of what was built and verified:

**Implemented (RFC compliance)**
- RFC 5545 core: complete content-line lexer (folding/unfolding), all component types (VEVENT, VTODO, VJOURNAL, VFREEBUSY, VTIMEZONE, VAVAILABILITY), full property/parameter grammar
- RFC 6868: parameter value escaping (`^n`, `^'`, `^^`)
- RFC 5546 (iTIP): per-method required property validation with structured warnings
- RFC 7529 (RSCALE): unsupported variant warns via `rscale_unsupported`
- RFC 7953 (VAVAILABILITY): VAVAILABILITY + AVAILABLE sub-component parsing
- RFC 7986: calendar-level properties (NAME, DESCRIPTION, REFRESH-INTERVAL, SOURCE, COLOR, URL, CATEGORIES, IMAGE, CONFERENCE)
- RFC 9073/9074: VALARM extensions (UID, ACKNOWLEDGED, PROXIMITY, RELATED-TO on alarms)
- RFC 9253: RELATED-TO with RELTYPE parameters

**RRULE engine**
- All frequencies: SECONDLY, MINUTELY, HOURLY, DAILY, WEEKLY, MONTHLY, YEARLY
- Full BYxxx grammar: BYMONTH, BYWEEKNO, BYYEARDAY, BYMONTHDAY, BYDAY (with ±ordinals), BYHOUR, BYMINUTE, BYSECOND, BYSETPOS
- WKST affecting WEEKLY and BYWEEKNO, COUNT/UNTIL bounds
- DTSTART included only if it satisfies the RRULE
- RDATE independent of RRULE COUNT

**VTIMEZONE**: multi-observance with UNTIL-bounded transitions, pre-first-observance fallback, DST spring-forward gap (post-transition offset) and fall-back fold (fold=0/pre-transition)

**Override handling**: specific RECURRENCE-ID replacement, RANGE=THISANDFUTURE time-shifting, STATUS:CANCELLED propagation, orphan_override warnings

**Warning system**: `malformed_value`, `unresolved_tzid`, `orphan_override`, `duplicate_uid`, `exrule_deprecated`, `itip_missing_property`, `rscale_unsupported`, `line_too_long`
